initiatives.name: Dare to Struggle New Mexico
initiatives.description: New Mexico chapter of the national Dare to Struggle coalition, founded in Taos in 2024. Organizes protests on immigration enforcement, police violence and housing.

initiatives.name: Tewa Women United
initiatives.description: Native women-led group in northern New Mexico working on environmental justice, reproductive justice, and healing from violence, with programs for Native women and girls.

initiatives.name: New Mexico Immigrant Law Center
initiatives.description: Nonprofit that provides free legal help to low-income immigrants across New Mexico, with offices in Albuquerque, Santa Fe, and Las Cruces.

initiatives.name: Millions for Prisoners
initiatives.description: We seek to unite activists, advocates, prisoners, ex-prisoners, their family and friends. Abolish Slavery!
